name: Midwives Act certification framework
description: The 1902 Act created a framework for midwifery certification and oversight in England and Wales, including a Central Midwives Board.

date.label: 31 July 1902
date.basis: Date reported by the cited source.

events.statement: The 1902 Act created a framework for midwifery certification and oversight in England and Wales, including a Central Midwives Board.
events.caveats: Midwifery long predates the statute. The Act established a regulatory framework, and enforcement and practice changed over time; the original statute excluded Scotland and Ireland and used a women-only definition.

evidence.supports: The statute was enacted on 31 July 1902, provided for board formation and certification, and generally commenced 1 April 1903.

date.label: 1 April 1905
date.basis: Date written in section 1 of the 1902 Act.

events.statement: From 1 April 1905, the statute restricted use of the professional title to certified women.
events.caveats: This is the statutory provision, not evidence of enforcement or universal access to midwifery.

date.label: 1 April 1910
date.basis: Date written in section 1 of the 1902 Act.

events.statement: From 1 April 1910, the statute restricted habitual paid attendance at childbirth by uncertified women, subject to listed exceptions.
events.caveats: This is the statutory provision, not evidence of enforcement or universal access to midwifery.
